transcript: Create on-brand UI designs with no design experience required. First, head over to Replit Design and just describe what you're building in plain English. Their design agent will take it from there, laying out your page and suggesting what to do next at every step. Afterwards, upload your brand assets—your logo, your colors—and Replit's design agent will keep every design on-brand automatically. From your landing page to even the launch graphics, literally everything will match. Then you just iterate. Just say what you want it to change and it'll refine the design until it looks exactly like how you pictured it in your head. So if you want to give this a try, just comment "Design" down below and I'll send you the link directly.
